basics.name: Sanath Thilakarathna
basics.label: Mechatronics Engineer
basics.summary: Mechatronics Engineer and Lecturer with expertise in robotics, embedded systems, and automation, currently teaching at CINEC and actively engaged in research and technical content creation. Passionate about developing intelligent systems, sustainable manufacturing solutions, and advancing engineering education.

work.name: CINEC Campus
work.summary: Currently serving as a Lecturer in Mechatronics Engineering at CINEC, delivering modules in electronics, automation, robotics, and control systems. Responsible for curriculum development, practical lab supervision, assessment preparation, and guiding student projects, with a focus on industry relevance and hands-on learning.

education.institution: Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa
courses: Sensors and Actuators for Automation, Embedded Systems Design and Implemntation, Mechatronics, Industrial Robotics, Digital Controls, Real-time Systems
